title: 同视频离线算法对照：困难 RC 选段
comparison: FEAR-R baseline vs P28, offline replay
display_sampling: Every second source frame; two panels use the same decoded image and source ordinal.
limitations: Mac offline replay, not phone performance or a commercial product comparison.
Geometric reference IoU >= 0.5; does not certify target identity.
Selected diagnostic window is not an independent generalization benchmark.
P28 errors before recovery and absent-target output are retained.
Display zoom uses the same reference-centered crop on both sides; never fed into either model.
Offline refers to the outer evaluation loop; the P28 internal detector retains its original asynchronous scheduling.
